name: Harem Game 2 ~Futsuu ja Nai Shujinkou ga Harem o Kizuku Fantasy (?)~
original_name: ハーレムゲーム２ ～普通じゃない主人公がハーレムを築くファンタジー（？）～
source:
The protagonist is Kohei, a young vagrant making a living by stealing. One day, he accidently summons a devil. Usually, in order to borrow its power, one must offer their soul in exchange. 

However, this devil is quite an eccentric. It shows interest in Japanese entertainment, so it just gives the power to Kohei and runs off to play around.

And thus, as someone who grows up in a rough environment, Kohei is going to abuse this power and do whatever he wants.

[Translated from [url=http://www.interheart.co.jp/index.php?cID=617]Official Site[/url]]
